Sarah Koenig's season-long investigation that made the true-crime podcast a form.

How Serial connects

  • Artist: Sarah Koenig — Sarah Koenig hosts and reports Serial.
  • Work: Serial Season 1 — Season 1 is Serial's first and defining season.
  • Artist: Julie Snyder — Julie Snyder co-created and produces Serial.
  • Faction: Serial Productions — Serial Productions produces Serial.
  • Work: This American Life — This American Life incubated and first distributed Serial.
  • Work: Serial Season 2 — Season 2 is Serial's Bowe Bergdahl season.
  • Work: Serial Season 3 — Season 3 is Serial's Cleveland courthouse season.
  • Character: Ira Glass — Ira Glass's shop midwifed Serial as a This American Life spin-off.

What is Serial?

Serial is the This American Life spin-off Sarah Koenig and Julie Snyder launched in 2014: one case per season, starting with Adnan Syed and Hae Min Lee in Baltimore, produced by Serial Productions and later owned with the New York Times.

Key threads lead to Sarah Koenig, Serial Season 1, Julie Snyder, Serial Productions, This American Life and Serial Season 2.
